notes.title: Steam Scream Fest Sale and The Hanged Man Update
notes.notes:
Hey there! 

After some long silence, I would like to inform you that No one lives under the lighthouse Director's cut is currently having its biggest discount since its release more than 2.5 years ago. Oh, it seems like we were developing the game just yesterday.

And that's because we were - in this spooky time of year, we can't resist a bit of honest lighthouse keeper job. During last weeks we've updated many small things you probably won't even notice - stuff that doesn't matter really that much for those who have already finished NOLUL DC, but may help creating a bit better impression for those who haven't played the game yet.

[previewyoutube=TpUah2fpxik;full][/previewyoutube]

I can't give you any kind of changelog, as that would ruin the mystery - so I'll just say we've updated some cutscenes, added bits of level design and improved some encounters, and made some really small updates to the island (during some of the days). Tweaked the difficulty in a way. Fixed some bugs and user experience issues. Remade some 3D props. Added more seagulls. Made one achievement a bit easier to achieve (guess which one). 

It's fun to come back to your creation after a while. During those weeks of work, we've made the overall experience a little bit smoother, even though this doesn't bring big changes (sorry, but if you don't love DC, you won't love it now). Though there are some big things - No one lives under the lighthouse Director's cut is now available in Turkish and German translations. Huge thanks to R. Eralp Çeçen (original game translation) and Yusuf Yılgör (Director's cut & Steam page translation) for Turkish language support, and to Sina Dehkalani (@frauenname) for the German translation. They've done incredible job!

We've also updated the game splash logo (that you see after launching the exe), as almost half a year ago we changed from Sowoke Entertainment Bureau to Marevo Collective since our team has grown and changed as well.

Hope you have some good time in the game and spend the spooky season with fun!

notes.title: Spooktober Update is live; few other news
notes.notes:
First things first - Spooktober update is live and ready to be downloaded. It features:

- Updates to 2 of 3 endings 
- Updates to Lamp, Oiler, and Shovel models 
- In-game achievements menu
- Main menu UI sounds a bit different and more PSX'y
- Small rain update, which makes it way less heavy for your PC;
- We fixed some bugs in the stealth section which was very hard to complete without a gun
- Added translations to Italian, Polish and Hungarian, thanks to Luca Cassinelli, Krzysztof Gmyr, and Brechler "lostprophet" Zsolt
- Main menu now features links to out Twitter and Discord server, where you can read all the news. Wait, what?

Discord server

Is opened. A place where you can ask us anything, send memes, artwork, communicate and read news about our games and development process. 

https://discord.gg/tkvpapWA75

HOLLOWSK 1999 3D

Also, we've announced a new game today - Hollowsk 1999 3D. It's a horror adventure game set in post-soviet city drowned in a nightmare. Check it out, be sure to wishlist and follow it to receive news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684460/Hollowsk_1999_3D/
I've also bought a cool domain for it soviethill.com :smile:

Would like to hear your opinions on the endings, as one of them I think may be one of the best things I've done in terms of horror.

notes.title: Director's Cut update and OST released
notes.notes:
Free update is available to download for all game owners. The features list is below. If you want to support us please consider purchasing freshly released OST. Also please leave a review for the game if you didn't yet - that helps a lot, that's basically our most efficient marketing tool [spoiler]as our marketing budget is $0[/spoiler].

Features:
- Mac and Linux versions
- Controller support
- New settings (mouse inversion, key mapping, mouse sensitivity) 
- Level selection from the menu
- Almost half of the game (second half, to be clear) is remade, including all of the endings;
- Some of the first half of the game scenes are updated too;
- 2 challenging (but not too challenging, I guess) boss fights; 
- Some of the game's scenes that frustrate people more than the others are now skippable
- Changed more than half of achievements. Sadly, that means you've lost their old versions
- Storyline is updated to express the original ideas;
- More seagulls;
- As it was promised a year ago, sandbags are now 3D model

Maybe we'll also add stuff like Steam Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges, and Profile Backgrounds soon, but I'm not sure and can't promise that.

We love you ːisaacː 
Have fun and leave your feedback here.

P.S. Old version of the game will be available as Beta in few days, I'll post the instruction on how to play it.

notes.title: Remember Isolated Year Update?
notes.notes:
Many people haven't heard anything from us in a while - I'm sorry, developing the update took much longer than I expected. 

The Isolated Year Update - that we've decided to call Director's cut for simplicity and marketing purpose (everyone knows what Director's cut is) - is coming out tomorrow, 12.09.2021.

[previewyoutube=2PatRUhX-z0;full][/previewyoutube]

I'll publish a full list of updated things tomorrow, but right now I may give you a shorter one: half of the game remade, achievements changed, endings changed (maybe it will be a disappointing change for someone), the storyline makes more sense and closer to the original idea even though you may not think so from the first time you play, 2 BOSSFIGHTS in a walking sim with actual challenging gameplay holy crap; better settings, level selection (no new game for achievement farming), controller support, Mac and Linux versions, a sexy intro with our company logo and an OST release. 

Everything is for free (well, not OST) and included as a part of the base game, as I hate DLC's. Though if you want to support us you may purchase the OST, it also releases tomorrow.

Oh yeah, if you liked the old labyrinth level it's your last day to enjoy it. 

P.S. I'm sorry for folks who lost their achievements without any warning from our side - I was sure the achievement update is not public yet, as I haven't pressed "Publish" button for it in Steam developer dashboard. 

Also, I'm sorry for many questions being unanswered in discussions. I always thought I should get a notification if there are new discussions, and thought there are none - obviously, I was wrong.

Follow us on Twitter if you want to see more unexpected name changes for free updates https://twitter.com/sowokegames

notes.title: Patch 1.01 released
notes.notes:
The first-day patch is done!

Updates:

- We've fixed colliders in [spoiler]Temple[/spoiler] level. Now you shouldn't fall. 
- But even if you somehow do, Restart in the menu should now restart this exact level. Not sure if it works at all levels, but it definitely works in [spoiler]Temple[/spoiler] level.
- Bridge on the beach now shouldn't lock you inside. You're free, my friend!
- Fixed the water level on some parts of Day 5
- Now you can't see the opened chest from the behind of the house
- And if you forgot your briefcase no one will steal it (yep, that one wasn't intended)
- High priestess achievement now works fine. 
- Other minor fixes we can't remember

Next plans:

- Less common bugs
- Sound from the game playing in pause menu fix
- Wooden planks texture fix
- We'll check the player spawns once again. At least two people have fallen through the ground after exiting a building or going down the stairs. We can't reproduce it, but we'll do our best to find out the reason.
- Will add a ladder under the lighthouse probably
- New settings - change mouse sensitivity and invert controls
- We're discussing a small rework of [spoiler]Temple[/spoiler] level, adding a bit more of a puzzle element to it. I love hove it looks, however, I'm not sure I love how it feels.
- Another way to get 3rd ending
- Controller support
- Sacks!

Maybe:

- Achievement guide
- We thought once about hints for the game, as some of the quests may be unclear, but most seem to complete the game without big issues or at max stuck at something but making it out in few mins. I'm still not sure about if it's actually needed or not. I think it's better to do it.

-- 

Thanks for everyone who bought the game, shared feedback, reported bugs, or left a review! Each review helps us a lot! Bug reports also do that! 

Ask your questions in community hub - I try to answer each one of you as soon as I can while I'm not busy at my regular work (I'm not a full-time developer lol)! <3

Also:

Bring your ideas and suggestions here
Report any issue that seems like it's not intended here

notes.title: We moved the release date
notes.notes:
We are sorry to say that, but we can't release the game today. It works almost fine, definitely can be called playable, but we need to handle critical bugs and polish some parts of it. 

We estimate the game to be finished by Tuesday, April 21. Currently, we're getting our coffee done and prepare for the weekend journey full of fixes and updates. 

You can never make it perfect, but it's always worth trying. ːtragedianː
